He said this would stop "Iran's ships or customers" from entering or leaving the key oil shipping route, but "all other countries will have fair and open use of the Strait". The blockade will be in effect from 16:00 Eastern Time (20:00 GMT) on Tuesday.

Iran's foreign minister later said whoever provides safe passage "should be compensated for this service", but Iran would remain the strait's "GUARDIAN" - using Trump's word.

Tehran and Washington clashed over the strait's control after exchanging strikes in the region overnight.

The US said it carried out strikes against military targets in Iran, targeting air defence systems, coastal radars, and missile and drone sites.

Iran said it responded by striking US military bases in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain, and radars in Oman.

In Trump's Truth Social post on Monday, he insisted the strait "will remain OPEN, with or without Iran".

"The U.S.A. will be, from this point forward, known as "THE GUARDIAN OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT," but as such, and as a matter of FAIRNESS, will be reimbursed, at the rate of 20% on all cargo shipped, for any and all costs necessary to do the job of providing safety and security to this very volatile section of the World," he wrote.

The US president added that "the process and formation will begin immediately".

His comments came shortly after he told Fox News the US would "probably run" the Strait of Hormuz, claiming that Iran "broke" a deal that was made with the US.

"We are taking over the strait," he said.

"The US military continues to support traffic flow through regional waters for all vessels not violating the blockade," a Centcom statement said.

He continued: "Iran has always been the GUARDIAN of the Strait and will remain so FOREVER."

"20% is of course too much. We will be fair," Araghchi added.

payload.title: Trump ilmoitti palauttavansa Iranin merisaarron ja määräävänsä Hormuzin rahdille 20 prosentin maksun
payload.summary: Yhdysvallat aikoo palauttaa Iranin satamiin kohdistuvan merisaarron ja periä Hormuzinsalmen kautta kulkevalta rahdilta 20 prosentin maksun. Iran vastustaa Yhdysvaltain toimia ja katsoo itse olevansa salmen suojelija.
payload.content:
Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trump on ilmoittanut maansa palauttavan Iranin satamiin kohdistuvan merisaarron ja ottavan operatiivisen määräysvallan Hormuzinsalmessa. Samalla Yhdysvallat aikoo periä salmen kautta kulkevalta rahdilta 20 prosentin maksun. Saarron on määrä tulla voimaan tiistaina kello 20 koordinoitua yleisaikaa.

## Trump lupaa pitää salmen avoinna

Trump kuvasi Truth Social -palvelussa Yhdysvaltoja vesiväylän suojelijaksi. Hänen mukaansa operaatio estää Iranin aluksia ja Iranin asiakkaita saapumasta keskeiselle öljynkuljetusreitille tai poistumasta sieltä. Trump vakuutti muiden maiden saavan käyttää salmea vapaasti ja avoimesti sekä kirjoitti sen pysyvän avoinna Iranin toimista riippumatta.

Yhdysvaltain asevoimat kertoi jatkavansa Hormuzinsalmen saartoa tiistaina. Trump oli aiemmin sanonut operaation käynnistyvän välittömästi. Hänen maanantaina julkaisemansa ilmoituksen mukaan kyseessä on nimenomaan Iraniin kohdistuva saarto, vaikka 20 prosentin maksu on tarkoitus määrätä kaikelle salmen kautta kulkevalle rahdille.

Maksun käytännön toteutus on vielä epäselvä. Julkisuuteen ei ole kerrottu, miten Yhdysvallat perisi maksun kaikilta salmen kautta kuljetettavilta lasteiltа tai kuinka se valvoisi järjestelyä. Trump kuvasi maksua turvallisuudesta perittäväksi korvaukseksi, mutta tarkempia toimintatapoja ei ilmoituksen yhteydessä esitetty.

## Iran torjuu Yhdysvaltain määräysvallan

Iranin ulkoministeri Abbas Araghchi vastasi Trumpille, että Iran on aina ollut salmen suojelija. Araghchin mukaan turvallisen kulun takaavalle osapuolelle pitäisi maksaa korvaus sen tarjoamasta palvelusta, mutta Iran pysyy Hormuzinsalmen suojelijana. Iranin asevoimat oli jo ennen Yhdysvaltain ilmoitusta sanonut, ettei se hyväksy Yhdysvaltain puuttumista tärkeän laivareitin hallintaan.

Teheranin ja Washingtonin kiista salmen määräysvallasta kärjistyi maiden vaihdettua iskuja alueella yön aikana. Yhdysvaltain asevoimien aluejohto kertoi iskeneensä sukellusveneeseen ja iranilaiseen laivojen huoltolaitokseen. Sen mukaan iskut olivat vastaus Iranin Hormuzinsalmessa kaupallisiin aluksiin kohdistamiin hyökkäyksiin. Ilmoitettu saarto yhdistää siten sotilaallisen operaation ja uuden rahtimaksun, jonka soveltamistapa on yhä avoin.

President Donald Trump also said the US will impose a 20% charge on all Strait of Hormuz cargo President Donald Trump has said the US is reinstating a naval blockade of Iranian ports and will impose a 20% charge on all cargo shipped through the Strait of Hormuz. He said this would stop "Iran's ships or customers" from entering or leaving the key oil shipping route, but "all other countries will have fair and open use of the Strait". The blockade will be in effect from 16:00 Eastern Time (20:00 GMT) on Tuesday. Iran's foreign minister later said whoever provides safe passage "should be compensated for this service", but Iran would remain the strait's "GUARDIAN" - using Trump's word. Tehran and Washington clashed over the strait's control after exchanging strikes in the region overnight.

The US president also says Washington will charge a 20% toll on all cargo shipped through the Strait of Hormuz.

The US military says it will resume its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz from Tuesday - earlier, Donald Trump said the operation was restarting "immediately" The president said on Truth Social the US would be the "guardian" of the waterway and impose a 20% charge on all cargo passing through - how this will work in practice is unclear, writes our White House reporter Responding to Trump, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said his country had "always been the guardian of the strait" Before the US announcement, Iran's military said it wouldn't allow the US to "interfere in the management" of the key shipping route Meanwhile, US Central Command says it hit a submarine and Iranian ship maintenance facility overnight in response to Iran targeting commercial ships in the strait

President Donald Trump announced Monday on Truth Social that the United States military is officially reinstating its naval blockade of Iranian ports and taking operational control of the Strait of Hormuz, forcing all transiting cargo to pay a 20% security fee. The presidential declaration introduces a direct financial and military countermeasure to the spiraling maritime conflict. “The Hormuz Strait is OPEN, and will remain OPEN, with or without Iran,” Trump wrote on Truth Social. “We are reinstating THE IRANIAN BLOCKADE, so named because it is only stopping Iran’s ships or customers from entering or leaving. All other countries will have fair and open use of the Strait.”
